reason: Free listing I'd take, since they load the flyers for me and it costs nothing. But I wouldn't pay for anything today: nobody knows how many people really use this app in my town, and I'm tired of boosts that give me no real numbers.
objection: How many people actually use this app here? Until I see a real, published monthly user count for my city I can't tell if the stats or pushes are worth anything.
would_change_my_mind: The published monthly active users in my city passing 2,000, plus a sample stats report showing real views, saves and shares per night that I can compare against what I get from Instagram.
